body.p: A hare and a wolverine. A hare ran along a road. An old wolverine ran towards him. "Where did you come from, hare? "I walked off-road for several days. My legs hurt, my head hurts, I have no strength. I am going back." The wolverine said: "Don't go. If you go back, you'll fall into a trap on the road. Surely, a man has already installed a trap. Don't go back, go forward. If you go along a new road, you will find something, you will not be killed, you will not fall into a trap." Their roads diverged in different directions. The hare did not follow the advice and went back. He thought that he had not obeyed the old wolverine before and had lived well. "Why should she teach me now?" He went back. In the evening, Wolverine goes home. "Oh, what is lying there?" The hare lies across the road, eyes closed, mouth open. He died, he became completely cold. He fell into a trap. Only his ears are visible. The wolverine feels sorry for the hare. The wolverine thought: "He did not listen the old woman, so he died."
